premise: The earlier test chose the first complete holder records per stratum. Those results motivated the prospective prediction below. No full-record tables were computed for nonselected occurrences before this design.
question: Does every single physical shared distinction at first meeting in the original most-held cohort have a proper two-sided common hub on both exclusive holder records?
population: Every route occurrence (case, knot law, split, first meeting, two distinct parts, phase, witness, two pure holders, physical c) with c in both holders and their witness, from the same 205 interleaved cases under MOST; include actual cross takes from the opposing holder. Repeat counts when physical records recur at different splits or phases. Exclude no occurrence by strength of its attachment.
prediction: Every nonempty exclusive pair factors conditional on c, with two proper attachments. In particular no independent side-local binary readings can make a ternary knot. Empty arms, nonproducts, or a nonrestrictive arm qualify and are reported as exceptions. A route whose arms use different places stays separate.
measurement: Hold every exclusive place on the two endpoint knots plus c, forgetting other shared places. Decide the complete conditional product and each proper arm, with both projection methods from the precursor or a sufficient elimination certificate that preserves the whole stage confirmed by an independent calculation. Exact stage/support/physical tuple memoization may be used. Export the classes/vacuous cases, including unique physical checks and occurrence multiplicity per law.
resources: Measure occurrence widths and duplicate keys before scientific tables and time exact configurations first. Up to four workers each and about an hour per run; if needed take a leading prefix of the original interleaved order. No unrun occurrence counts as a negative.
decision: Accept universal only on the completed finite population if every physical candidate was checked by two methods. Publish first physical counterexample or list unrun cases otherwise. No extension to arbitrary future stages.
